title: Count the digits
starter:
let rec count_digits n =
  if n < 10 then 1 else 2
hints: `n / 10` drops the last digit: `12345 / 10` is `1234`. How many digits does `n` have compared with `n / 10`?
One more than `n / 10` has, as long as `n` has at least two digits. Numbers below 10 have one digit.
explain: Integer division by 10 drops the last digit, so `n` has one more digit than `n / 10`. Recursing on `n / 10` until the number is below 10 counts them. 0 is below 10, so it counts as one digit.
